'''Desert Bloom''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage served at [[Bantha Traxx]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It sold for nine [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a glass.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
